# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

Servicing release backporting Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixing WinUI Projection DLL loading.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 unversioned TFM backport** — Backports the unversioned Apple app TFM support and 26.0 library targeting from later branches so apps on this line can target the newer Apple SDKs. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9** — Fixes a packaging issue that left the WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers, causing load failures at startup. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
